subject: Request: Temporary archive carveout & cross-border log exclusion
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@greenwavehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Legal <legal@greenwavehealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-27T09:18:00-04:00
Subject: Request: temporary archive carveout for EU pilot (logs + backup purge)

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Greenwave's engineering team is excited about the latency improvements. One item that came up in our compliance review: for the upcoming pilot with EU clinics we need a temporary carveout to retain operational logs and backups for 90 days (current Redwood default is 30 days) to support an audit window. We also need confirmation that any cross-border transfers are covered by SCCs and that the list of subprocessors for backups/archival is provided.

Can Redwood accept a 90-day retention for the pilot window (expected start 2027-07-08 for ~8 weeks), and provide:
- A short ops runbook describing the backup purge timeline for the pilot (who triggers purge, rollback options)
- Confirmation of subprocessors involved in snapshot/backup storage (including region where backups will reside)
- A signed acknowledgement of SCCs for transfers out of the EU or an explanation of encryption/controls to avoid transfers

I attached our log-exception-form with the fields we need filled. Let me know if you want to triage by phone — we need a formal reply for our legal team by EOD Friday 2027-06-30.

Thanks,
Samantha Ortiz
Head of IT Compliance
Greenwave Health

Attachments: greenwave-log-exception-form.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@greenwavehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-06-27T11:07:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary archive carveout for EU pilot (logs + backup purge)

Samantha — thanks for the note and the form. Looping in Kimberly (Legal) and Neha (Security) so we can get you a consolidated reply. High-level answers up front: we can provision a pilot-specific retention tweak and provide a short runbook and subprocessors list. We need to confirm a couple of operational details before committing to 90 days for backups (vs. logs):

Questions for you:
1) Is the 90-day ask for both per-request operational logs (agg + tracing) and immutable snapshot backups, or only for logs?
2) Will the pilot data be ER restricted (PHI equivalent) such that we need on-prem or VPC-only backup targets?
3) Do you require the backups to stay in EU region physically, or are SCCs acceptable to permit cross-border storage?

Kimberly — can you draft the short acknowledgement for SCCs and confirm if an SLA amendment is needed for a time-limited exception? Neha — please advise on security controls for encrypted in-transit and at-rest handling for snapshot exports and whether we can avoid EU->US transfer by encrypting client-managed keys. Marissa — ops: can you produce a one-page purge timeline (triggered by pilot end or by legal signal) with rollback options?

We should be able to get a formal reply + draft SLA amendment back to Samantha by EOD 2027-06-30.

—Vivek
VP, Product Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>, Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@greenwavehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-06-28T09:22:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary archive carveout for EU pilot (logs + backup purge)

Samantha / team — short legal response below and an attached draft amendment to cover the pilot timeframe. Points:

- Retention scope: Redwood can approve a 90-day retention carveout for operational logs (access logs, runtime traces) and for managed backups used for disaster recovery for the limited pilot period, provided the scope is limited to the pilot account ids you supplied in the attached form. We cannot extend to long-term archival buckets without a separate agreement.
- Subprocessors: primary subprocessors for backups are CloudLane Storage (EU region), ArchiveSafe (long-term snapshot service, with EU nodes), and LogStream (ingestion/aggregation). We will provide a CSV with endpoints and contact information in the final package.
- Cross-border transfers / SCCs: Redwood is prepared to execute SCCs for transfers outside the EU. As an alternative, we can keep backups in EU regions and use a customer-managed KMS to ensure keys never leave the EU (this avoids personal data transfer). We'll need Greenwave to indicate which option you prefer.

I attach an SLA amendment template (redwood-sla-amendment-v1.docx) with a 90-day window placeholder (start/end dates) and the limited-scope clause. If Greenwave signs and returns, Ops will apply the retention policy to the pilot account and Ops+Security will coordinate a temporary export hold until the pilot end.

Neha / Marissa please confirm the ops purge/runbook specifics and the list of subprocessor endpoints so I can include them in the amendment.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-sla-amendment-v1.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@greenwavehealth.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-06-29T14:45:00-04:00
Subject: RE: Request: temporary archive carveout for EU pilot (logs + backup purge)

Hi Samantha — operational runbook and timeline below (brief):

Summary: For the pilot account (Account ID: GW-PILOT-88), Redwood will apply the following temporary retention controls once the signed SLA amendment is received and the pilot start date is confirmed:

1) Logs (access + runtime traces)
   - Retention: 90 days from event timestamp.
   - Storage: EU-central log cluster (no cross-border replication).
   - Purge trigger: automated purge job scheduled daily; legal hold flag can pause purge for specific IDs.
   - Rollback: within 48 hours we can restore logs from immutable snapshot if flagged before purge completion (restore window 48 hrs).

2) Backups / snapshots (managed)
   - Retention: 90 days for pilot snapshots stored in EU storage.
   - Purge timeline: snapshots older than 90 days will be marked for deletion and a purge job will run nightly; deletion completes within 24 hours of purge job.
   - Emergency rollback: if a restore is requested before deletion completes, Ops will snapshot the snapshot and begin restore; final deletion may be paused via legal hold.

3) Controls / subprocessors
   - Backups will remain in EU nodes (CloudLane / ArchiveSafe). We will provide endpoint list and subprocessor contacts as an export.
   - For any cross-border handling we will use SCCs or customer-managed KMS as Kimberly suggested.

Next steps:
- Kimberly: please attach the signed amendment with start/end dates (we recommend 2027-07-08 to 2027-09-01 for the pilot).
- Samantha: confirm EU-only storage or indicate preference for SCCs+CMK.
- Once signed, Ops will schedule the retention policy change and provide a runbook URL + a short test checklist.

Thanks — more detail available if you want a walkthrough meeting.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: sccs-acknowledgement.txt
